title: Data replication operation (formlogic-data-sync/1)
description: One signed, idempotent logical operation in a dataset's replication log (docs/FORMLOGIC_DESKTOP_ENCRYPTED_DATA_NODES_PLAN.md §12). Serialized with flcanon/1; signature domain flop:1; operationHash = SHA-256 over the flop:1 preimage of the operation WITHOUT its signature. The signer key/generation must be authorised by the owner-signed placement manifest — a key carried only in the operation is never trusted. Sequence is dataset-global, contiguous, and never resets at an epoch change. Duplicate operationId + identical hash = no-op; duplicate operationId + different bytes = sync_integrity_collision (lane blocked).

encryptionManifestHash.description: Hash binding to exactly one already-committed immutable signed public-form manifest (distinct from placementManifestHash). Required for response.* and attachment.* kinds.

entityId.description: Record/file/artifact id. Required for response.*, attachment.*, schema.put, manifest.put.

baseRev.description: response.envelope.put only: must equal the local envelope rev.

expectedRowVersion.description: CAS guard for every mutation of a live row; absent for response.create.

rowVersion.description: Resulting row version; response.create starts at 1; every other row mutation = expectedRowVersion + 1.

cipherHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact canonical __flenc envelope bytes (never plaintext). Present for response.create/envelope.put; retained unchanged by status/trash/restore.

payload.description: Kind-specific body, e.g. { envelope, updatedAt } for response.create/envelope.put, { status, updatedAt } for response.status.set, tombstone detail for response.delete, exact recoveryAuthorization copy for dataset.recovery.restore. Complete-row semantics: unknown columns are a protocol-version error, never dropped.

previousOperationHash.description: Hash chain; null only for sequence 1.
